```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

# Define a consistent medical color mpalette for visual identity across all plots
ecg_palette <- c(
  "Normal" = "#4a4b4c",
  "Arrhythmia" = "#d73027",
  "Normal Reference" = "#b3b4b5"
)

zip_path <- "../data/mitbih_test.zip"

# Stream data directly from ZIP archive to optimize disk usage
ecg_raw <- read_csv(unz(zip_path, "mitbih_test.csv"), col_names = FALSE)

colnames(ecg_raw) <- c(paste0("t", 1:(ncol(ecg_raw) - 1)), "label")

# Map numeric labels to clinical categories and group by diagnostic significance
ecg_clean <- ecg_raw %>% 
  mutate(
    label_name = case_when(
      label == 0 ~ "Normal",
      label == 1 ~ "Supraventricular",
      label == 2 ~ "Ventricular",
      label == 3 ~ "Fusion",
      label == 4 ~ "Unclassified",
      TRUE ~ as.character(label)
    ),
    # Grouping for high-level morphological comparision
    color_group = ifelse(label == 0, "Normal", "Arrhythmia")
  )

# Setting a seed ensures that the 'random' selections is the same every time
set.seed(20)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-raw-representative
#| fig-cap: "Representative raw samples compared to healthy baseline."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10

# Get one representative raw samle for each abnormal class (1-4)
raw_samples <- ecg_clean %>% 
  filter(label != 0) %>% 
  group_by(label_name) %>% 
  slice_sample(n = 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("t"), names_to = "time", values_to = "raw_amp") %>% 
  mutate(time = as.numeric(gsub("t", "", time)))

# Get a single 'Normal' beat to serveas the 'Healthy Reference' background
normal_baseline <- raw_sample_normal %>% 
  select(time, normal_sample_amplitude)

# Combine for plotting
plot_data_representative <- raw_samples %>% 
  left_join(normal_baseline, by = "time")

# Visualization
ggplot(plot_data_representative, aes(x = time)) +
  # Background - healthy baseline reference for morphological comparison
  geom_line(aes(y = normal_sample_amplitude, color = "Normal Reference"),
            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  # Main signal - single raw representative heartbreat for each clinical category
  geom_line(aes(y = raw_amp, color = color_group), linewidth = 0.8) +

  facet_wrap(~ label_name, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  # Applying the global medicine palette
  scale_color_manual(values = ecg_palette) +
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Individual Arrhythmia Heartbeat Samples",
    subtitle = "Single-sample morphology comparison against a healthy reference",
    x = "Normalized Time Index (t)",
    y = "Voltage Amplitude (mV)",
    color = "Clinical Status"
  ) +
  
  # Styling the plot
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-arrhythmia-distribution
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of pathological samples."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

# Data preparation
arrhythmia_counts <- ecg_clean %>% 
  filter(label_name != "Normal") %>% 
  count(label_name, color_group) %>% 
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
    label_text = sprintf("%s (%.1f%%)", scales::comma(n), percentage)
  )
# Data visualization
ggplot(arrhythmia_counts, aes(x = reorder(label_name, n), y = n, fill = color_group)) +
  # Horizontal bars for better readability
  geom_col(width = 0.7, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # Labels
  geom_text(aes(label = label_text),
            hjust = -0.1,
            size = 3.8,
            fontface = "bold") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ecg_palette) +
  # Ensure space for text on the right side
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Prevalence of Arrhythmia Sub-classes",
    subtitle = "Relative distribution of pathological samples",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of Samples (n)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-arrhythmia-variance
#| fig-cap: "Intra-class variance across abnormal heartbeat categories."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10

# Aggregating data to show the essense of each class plus its variability
stats_plot_data <- ecg_clean %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("t"), names_to = "time", values_to = "amplitude") %>% 
  mutate(time = as.numeric(gsub("t", "", time))) %>% 
  group_by(label_name, color_group, time) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_amp = mean(amplitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_amp = sd(amplitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Filtering data to focus only on Arrhythmias
pathology_stats <- stats_plot_data %>% 
  filter(label_name != "Normal")

# Visualization
ggplot(pathology_stats, aes(x = time)) +
  # Class-specific variability (ribbon)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_amp - sd_amp, ymax = mean_amp + sd_amp,
                  fill = color_group), alpha = 0.15) +
  
  # Primary mean signal line
  geom_line(aes(y = mean_amp, color = color_group), linewidth = 1) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ label_name, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  
  # Colot mapping
  scale_color_manual(values = ecg_palette) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ecg_palette) +
  labs(
    title = "Statistical Class Morphology Analysys",
    subtitle = "Aggregated mean waveforms with +/- 1 standard deviation confidence ribbons",
    x = "Normalized Time Index (t)",
    y = "Voltage Amplitude (mV)",
    color = "Clinical Status",
    fill = "Clinical Status"
  ) +
  
  # Styling the plot
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "none", # legend removed: redundant with facet title
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
  )
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 12
#| fig-width: 9
#| warning: false

# Preprocessing
ecg_time_stats <- ecg_clean %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = row_number()) %>% 
  filter(label != 0) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("t"), names_to = "time", values_to = "amplitude") %>% 
  mutate(time = as.numeric(str_remove(time, "t"))) %>% 
  # Skip points with t < 10 - remove initial artefact
  filter(time > 10) %>% 
  # Find peak for each sample
  group_by(sample_id, label_name, color_group) %>% 
  summarise(
    r_peak_time = time[which.max(amplitude)],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Data visualization
ggplot(ecg_time_stats, aes(x = label_name, y = r_peak_time)) +
  # Violin plot 
  geom_violin(fill = ecg_palette["Arrhythmia"], alpha = 0.3, color = NA, scale = "width", trim = FALSE) +
  # Jitter
  geom_jitter(color = ecg_palette["Arrhythmia"], alpha = 0.5, width = 0.2, size = 0.3) +
  # Boxplot
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, color = "#001111", alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Temporal Instability of Pathological R-peaks",
    subtitle = "Combined view of raw data (jitter), density (violin), and statistics (boxplot)",
    x = "Arrhythmia Type",
    y = "R-Peak Position (Sample Index [t])"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```
